# Affordance adapter catalog

Regenerate with `python scripts/export_docs.py`.

| adapter | sources | private operations | denominator | completeness boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runtime` | `runtime` | `consult_advisor`, `noop`, `pause`, `read_fieldbook`, `recall_memory`, `set_speed`, `stop`, `wait` | Runtime control, playback, advisor, memory, and fieldbook state. | Only choices applicable to the current run state. |
| `game_bindings` | `game_binding` | `use_game_binding` | Every captured-default-keymap binding not owned by another adapter. | Witnessed bindings use effect terminals; unwitnessed bindings stop at accepted delivery plus a later observation. Playback, stateful screens, and camera rotation route through semantic adapters. |
| `screens` | `game_binding`, `visible_control` | `dismiss_screen`, `open_screen` | Observable named-screen states and currently open window captions. | Opening requires an observable exact terminal. Named-window dismissal uses a count terminal; uncaptained dismissal stops at delivery. Dialogue is excluded. |
| `visible_controls` | `dialogue`, `visible_control` | `activate_visible_control` | Every current non-item, non-runtime-owned visible control. | Ambiguous or stale controls fail exact rebinding. Activation proves exact delivery and a later observation, not the gameplay meaning of the result. |
| `context_orders` | `context_order` | `command_world_target`, `perform_context_action` | Every exact world-target/order pair advertised by current telemetry. | Native execution proves the reviewed natural-resource operate and squad-character first_aid semantics; other orders require current screen geometry and stop at the generic UI delivery boundary. |
| `body_shift` | `nearby_character` | `shift_into_body` | Every exact current conscious, non-animal, non-hostile nearby character. | Native-assisted stable identity and nearby-character evidence; a body outside the reported radius cannot be offered and a hostile one is deliberately withheld. |
| `character_orders` | `nearby_character` | `perform_character_order` | Every order Kenshi currently advertises on every probed nearby person. | Bounded by the native probe budget: the nearest few people are asked what they afford, and the rest report that they were not asked. |
| `inventory_owners` | `nearby_character` | `open_context_inventory` | Every squad member, nearby person, and nearby world target whose inventory is not already open. | Bounded to the nearest few owners. Whether one really has an inventory is Kenshi's answer at dispatch, not a guess here. |
| `item_transfers` | `inventory` | `transfer_item` | Every item in every open inventory, offered into every other open inventory. | Bounded to the first few moves. Whether one is allowed is Kenshi's answer at dispatch, reported in its own words. |
| `trade_windows` | `inventory` | `open_trade_window` | Every nearby person and squadmate whose inventory could be paired with the selected character's. | Bounded to the nearest few. Whether Kenshi pairs a given two is its answer at dispatch. |
| `dialogue_targets` | `dialogue` | `approach_dialogue_target` | Every exact current non-hostile character confirmed talkable. | Native-assisted stable identity and dialogue-role evidence. |
| `inventory` | `inventory` | `equip_item`, `purchase_item`, `sell_item` | Every current item cell with exact window ownership and item facts. | Transactions require unambiguous counterpart identity and conservation evidence. Equip currently proves exact delivery, not final equipment state. |
| `characters` | `composite_operation`, `nearby_character`, `squad` | `move_to_character`, `regroup_with_squad_member`, `respond_to_immediate_threat`, `select_squad_member_exact`, `use_game_binding` | Every exact current squad member and eligible nearby character. | Offers require the source-specific selection, identity, geometry, and safety facts. |
| `map` | `map` | `travel_to_map_destination` | Every currently known exact map destination. | Only destinations with authoritative current travel applicability. |
| `native_and_composite` | `composite_operation`, `native_operation`, `visible_control` | `exit_current_building`, `harvest_resource`, `move_in_direction`, `recover_camera_view`, `rotate_camera`, `scroll_screen`, `survey_local_resources` | Current state for native movement, camera, scrolling, and harvesting. | Only operations with a current binder and declared runtime completion boundary. Scrolling proves exact delivery, not newly revealed content. |

The playing model sees runtime instances of this registry, not the
private operation kinds in the table. Every selection is rebound
against the same adapter before an operation is materialized.
